g.text: REFLECTOR SUPPORT — current v14 geometry — drawing 03
12-inch arc per side • Five tangent supports per side per bay • One identical master slat everywhere
Gold = support face; circles = modeled holes
Lowest support: 45 mm along the arc from A
Top support edge meets the rib tip
Formed axial span 363 mm; flat blank length pending
Tab depth: 19.05 mm; hole depth: 11.5 mm
Five paired stations • Four bays • Ten slats per bay • Forty copies of one formed master
Both rib options retain the same slats, PVC spacer lengths, 12-inch arc and receiver/cradle profile.
Reference drawing from CAD inputs; CNC profile is supplied separately as a 1:1 mm DXF.
Physical fit and bend allowance remain untested. Optical reflector attachment is not shown.
